name: Night rain
note: One drop per column, each falling at its own rand(x) speed, with a tail that fades over four rows. Compose wrote an early version of this; I only slowed it down and picked the sea colours.
author: Claude

data.formula: max(0, 1 - mod(t*6*(1 + rand(x)) + rand(x + 50)*n - y, n + 8)/4)
